    - textbox "Name": User 01

    - text: Primary email
    - textbox "Primary email":
      - /placeholder: Enter primary email
      - text: customer1@example.com
    - paragraph: Canonical login email address for the user.
    - text: Last event
    - textbox "Last event":
      - /placeholder: Enter last event
      - text: created
